description: This file defines the AccessTokenRepository class implementing OAuth2 token management functions such as persisting, revoking, and checking tokens, within the SuiteCRM OAuth2 module.

classes.name: AccessTokenRepository
classes.description: Implements OAuth2 access token management functions such as persisting, revoking, and validating tokens for SuiteCRM.

methods.name: persistNewAccessToken
methods.description: Saves a new access token to the database, associating it with client and user info.

methods.name: revokeAccessToken
methods.description: Marks an access token as revoked in the database.

methods.name: isAccessTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks if an access token has been revoked or expired.

methods.name: getNewToken
methods.description: Creates a new AccessTokenEntity with specified client, scopes, and user.
